purpose: Primary-source provenance and isolated parser reproduction for BOOTSTRAP_APT_SOURCE_OPTIONS on supported Debian/Raspberry Pi OS 13 sources.

collection.networkReads: Public HTTPS upstream files read in memory with certificate verification; no package installation or archive extraction to disk. Existing observed results reused to write this report; no repeat network download for report creation.
collection.evidenceType: Observed upstream source/package bytes and actual local parser executions, not a user-Pi result.

debianReleaseNotes.retrieval: Browsed the official Debian 13 release notes.
debianReleaseNotes.finding: Trixie uses canonical .pgp keyring paths; .gpg paths are backward-compatibility symlinks scheduled for eventual removal.
debianReleaseNotes.scope: Documents Debian keyrings. Raspberry Pi compatibility was verified separately from its actual source and binary packages.

sourcePackage.inspection: Python tarfile read of Makefile and debian installation metadata in memory.

observedBuildAndInstall.Makefile: Builds keyrings/raspberrypi-archive-keyring.pgp, creates relative .gpg symlink to .pgp, installs .pgp and copies .gpg preserving the link into /usr/share/keyrings/.

binaryPackage.inspection: Parsed ar container and data.tar members in memory. No extraction, maintainer-script execution or installation.

raspberryPiArchiveKeyring.conclusion: The distributed package supplies the .gpg compatibility symlink. This does not prove it exists or is protected on the user Pi.

isolatedParserReproduction.method: Read old source with git show and current source from workspace; extract only parser class/functions/constants by Python AST; execute validate_apt_sources on exact upstream contents with RELEASE replaced by trixie. No preflight or installation entry point imported/executed.
isolatedParserReproduction.conclusion: Both official .pgp templates reproduce BOOTSTRAP_APT_SOURCE_OPTIONS before the fix and are accepted by the corrected parser.

limits.userPiAptConfiguration: UNKNOWN: requested diagnostic has not been received. These are upstream default templates, not readback of that Pi.
limits.otherTestFixtureProvenance: The separate repository unit-test fixture using security.debian.org is a valid compatibility fixture, not a byte-identical copy of pi-gen debian.sources; official pi-gen uses deb.debian.org/debian-security/.
limits.transportAuthentication: OS HTTPS certificate verification; recorded SHA256 fingerprints bind bytes read but do not independently verify the upstream APT signature chain.
